items.name: freestylefly/awesome-gpt-image-2
items.description: Prompt as Code ｜ GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库，530+ 个案例逆向工程，20+ 套工业级模板，并提炼出 Skills。
items.comment: 今日最大黑马，把 GPT-Image-2 跑出来的视觉案例反向蒸馏为可复用模板和 Skill，适合做电商图、品牌物料和短视频封面的团队直接 fork 套用。

items.name: openai/codex
items.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal.
items.comment: OpenAI 官方 CLI 编码代理，Rust 重写后稳定保持 Trending Top 3，是评测 GPT-5 系列代码能力的最佳本地客户端，支持 IDE/CLI/SDK 多端接入。

items.name: AprilNEA/OpenLogi
items.description: ⚡ A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry.
items.comment: 开源本地优先的罗技鼠标配置工具，无需登录、无遥测，针对 Logitech Options+ 限制越来越多的痛点开发，硬件玩家刚需。

items.name: basecamp/omarchy
items.comment: Basecamp 团队维护的"美观、现代、强观点" Linux 发行版，号称开箱即用的开发者桌面，与 Hyprland 深度集成，适合想摆脱 Ubuntu 默认桌面美学的工程师。

items.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
items.description: The agent that grows with you.
items.comment: Nous Research 推出的成长型 Agent 框架——能根据用户使用习惯持续学习和自我调整，是 Hermes 系列大模型之后的下一代行动层。

items.name: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code
items.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and OpenCode for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly).
items.comment: 免费使用 Claude Code 的统一客户端，整合 13 亿+ Token 的免费额度，支持终端/IDE/手机并兼容 OpenClaw 语音工作流，是薅羊毛派的甜点。

items.name: VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills
items.description: A curated collection of 1000+ agent skills from official dev teams and the community, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and more.
items.comment: 社区精选 1000+ Agent Skills 索引，覆盖 Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI / Cursor 等主流 Agent 客户端，是 Agent Skill 跨工具复用的发现入口。

items.name: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
items.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
items.comment: 把 Karpathy 对 LLM 编码陷阱的洞察蒸馏成单一 CLAUDE.md 文件，作为 Claude Code 的"系统级 prompt"使用，能显著减少幻觉与上下文漂移。

items.name: tinyhumansai/openhuman
items.description: Your Personal AI super intelligence. A brain that builds a local-first memory of your life, a fantastic orchestrator of agent fleets and workflows, and a deep researcher.
items.comment: 定位"个人 AI 超智"，核心是 local-first 长期记忆 + Agent 集群编排 + 深度研究三件套，强调数据归属用户，是 Obsidian 派系的精神续作。

items.name: anthropics/claude-plugins-community
items.description: Community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code. Read-only mirror — submit plugins at clau.de/plugin-directory-submission.
items.comment: Anthropic 官方运营的 Claude Code / Claude Cowork 社区插件市场镜像，所有 PR 通过提交链接流转，是 Claude 生态扩展的官方入口。

items.name: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
items.comment: 基于 Claude Code 的本地求职 Agent 框架：评估岗位 → 定制 CV → 写求职信 → 准备面试一条龙，所有数据留在本机，应届生与转码党神器。

items.name: apache/maka
items.description: Apache Maka (Incubating) is a local-first AI agent workspace. Model messages, tool calls, tool results, permission decisions, and termination events are recorded as an append-only log.
items.comment: Apache 基金会首个面向 AI Agent 的孵化项目。append-only 日志模式让 Agent 的所有消息、工具调用、权限决策都可追溯、可回放，企业级可观测性的新基线。

items.name: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
items.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
items.comment: 以"learn → build → ship"三段论组织 AI 工程实战教程，从底层原理到产品级落地，适合作为个人 AI 项目从学习到发布的路线图。

items.name: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian
items.description: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Drop any source and Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown you own. AI note-taking, PKM, and an open-source Notion alternative. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
items.comment: 把 Obsidian Vault + Claude Code 组合成自组织的第二大脑，扔进去任何资料 Claude 自动归档、链接并构建知识图谱，是 Karpathy "LLM Wiki"模式的最佳开源实践。

items.name: makeplane/plane
items.description: 🔥 Open-source Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp alternative. Plane is a modern project management platform to manage tasks, sprints, docs, and triage.
items.comment: Jira/Linear 的开源替代品，主打"现代化项目管理 + 任务/冲刺/文档/分流"全流程，对不想被 Jira 复杂度折磨的中小团队非常友好。

items.name: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
items.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Smart routing, automatic failover, encrypted keys. Personal experimentation only.
items.comment: 把 34 家免费 LLM 提供商的 635 个端点聚合到统一的 /v1 接口，并附带智能路由、故障转移、密钥加密，开发者无须在多个平台反复注册。

items.name: dani-garcia/vaultwarden
items.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs.
items.comment: Bitwarden 的非官方 Rust 自托管服务端，原名 bitwarden_rs，单二进制部署即可拥有完整密码同步能力，是隐私派自建密码库的事实标准。

items.name: openclaw/openclaw
items.description: Your own personal AI assistant. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
items.comment: 以"龙虾精神"自居的跨平台个人 AI 助手，覆盖任何操作系统，主要承担日常对话与命令代理角色，与 free-claude-code 形成"客户端+助手"组合。

items.name: PostHog/posthog
items.description: 🦔 PostHog is the leading platform for building self-driving products. AI observability, analytics, session replay, flags, experiments, error tracking, logs — all the context agents need, steerable from Slack, web, desktop, or MCP.
items.comment: 领先的开源产品分析平台，最近主推 AI 可观测性 + MCP 接口让 Agent 能直接调用 PostHog 数据，正从 SaaS 走向"自驾驶产品"基础设施。
